reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 9 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Thunder.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Bucks.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 80 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee (2-18) were knocked out of the Cup in Detroit on Friday and play again on the second night of a back-to-back. Taylor Jenkins says the team 'stopped trusting' what worked earlier. Oklahoma City expect Aday Mara and Jaylin Williams back, though Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are still out long-term. Everything leans Oklahoma City.
